li.label: calculating
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is always working out what someone is worth to {PAWN_objective}. {PAWN_pronoun} feels everything anyone else feels; {PAWN_pronoun} simply treats people as pieces to be placed. {PAWN_pronoun} would rather bind someone with a confidence than win an argument, and rarely lets a quarrel turn into a brawl.

li.label: machiavellian
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} plays a longer game than everyone around {PAWN_objective}. {PAWN_pronoun} feels everything anyone else feels, and uses people anyway.\n\n{PAWN_pronoun} does favours deliberately and remembers who owes {PAWN_objective}. Nobody in {PAWN_possessive} debt can bring themselves to insult {PAWN_objective}. {PAWN_pronoun} rates the people around {PAWN_objective} by what they contribute, quietly enjoys watching others fall out, and needs to be thought well of. {PAWN_pronoun} is hard to rattle, but when {PAWN_pronoun} finally breaks, {PAWN_pronoun} turns on whoever {PAWN_pronoun} had already written off.
